name: word-roller-multi-slot
title: Word Roller Multi Slot
description: Three slot-machine columns spin at once, each with its own word list, and stop one after another with a bounce, the landed words and column outlines turning to the accent colour.
useWhen: A tagline built from three independent choices (verb, article, noun) that spin and land on the final phrase.
A playful slot-machine reveal with a built-in sense of anticipation.
avoidWhen: A single changing word: use inline-word-roll or word-roller-slot-reveal.
Long words: the columns get wide and the row shrinks.
author: lifeprompt-team

variables.label: Column 1 words
variables.description: Words the first column spins through, separated by commas. The last one is where it stops.
variables.default: Make, Build, Create, Design, Craft, CREATE

variables.label: Column 2 words
variables.description: Words the second column spins through. The last one is where it stops.

variables.label: Column 3 words
variables.description: Words the third column spins through. The last one is where it stops.

variables.label: Font size
variables.description: Size of the column words in pixels. A wide row shrinks to fit the frame.

variables.label: Spinning color
variables.description: Color of the words while they spin.

variables.label: Landed color
variables.description: Color of the stopped words and the column outline.

variables.label: Background
variables.description: Fill behind the text. Use transparent to lay the block over your own footage.
